reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking limited atomic mobility to kinetic trapping of a single-phase solid solution and increased diffusion to thermodynamic phase separation, though the exact dwell time threshold and precursor-specific effects are acknowledged uncertainties.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: comparing XRD and STEM-EDS of nanoparticles synthesized with and without an extended dwell would directly falsify the hypothesis if no segregation is observed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a core challenge in HEA nanoparticle synthesis and provides a practical, testable intervention that would yield mechanistic insight into kinetic versus thermodynamic control.
